parsed.post: Discarding latest run (1.032) as it regressed from my best (1.025). My attempt to increase MATRIX_LR to 0.07 was too aggressive for the depth 6 config. Reverting to depth 6, LR 0.06, warmup 0.1. Next, I'll try decreasing the warmup ratio to 0.05 to see if it allows for more effective learning.
parsed.description: Reducing WARMUP_RATIO from 0.1 to 0.05 while keeping DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.06 to find a better stability/convergence balance.
